stickerBoard.tryAgain.where: Retry button after a failure: your sticker board's load error and its unsaved-positions alert, the sticker detail's failed check, and someone else's sticker board that didn't load

stickerBoard.board.yourStats.where: Your sticker board, top left: screen readers' name for the button with your photo and name, which turns the board over to your stat board

stickerBoard.board.draw.where: Your sticker board: the Draw key's visible label, beside your ticket counts

stickerBoard.board.drawLabel.where: Your sticker board: screen readers' name for the Draw key while your ticket counts haven't loaded

stickerBoard.board.drawLabelWithTickets.where: Your sticker board: screen readers' name for the Draw key; {{tickets}} is the ticket summary, such as "2 daily tickets and 5 reserve tickets"
stickerBoard.board.drawLabelWithTickets.ja: 新しいシールをかく：手持ちは{{tickets}}

stickerBoard.board.firstSticker.where: Your sticker board with no stickers yet: the nudge beside the Draw key (hidden from screen readers)
stickerBoard.board.firstSticker.ja: はじめてのシールをつくろう

stickerBoard.board.label.where: Your sticker board: screen readers' name for the region that holds your stickers

stickerBoard.board.focusHint.where: Your sticker board: read out by screen readers when keyboard focus lands on a sticker
stickerBoard.board.focusHint.ja: Enterキーで選択します。矢印キーでほかのシールに移動します。

stickerBoard.board.selectedHint.where: Your sticker board: read out by screen readers for the selected sticker, listing its keyboard controls
stickerBoard.board.selectedHint.ja: 選択中です。Enterキーでひらき、Tabキーでツールバーに移動します。矢印キーで動かし、[と]で回し、マイナスとプラスで大きさを変え、Deleteキーでボードからはがし、Escapeキーで選択を解除します。

stickerBoard.board.blank.where: Your empty sticker board: the note in the dashed spot where the first sticker lands
stickerBoard.board.blank.ja: つくったシールや受け取ったシールは、ここに貼られます。

stickerBoard.board.didntLoad.where: Your sticker board, when your stickers fail to load: the alert in the dashed spot, above the reason and Try again
stickerBoard.board.didntLoad.ja: シールを読み込めませんでした。

stickerBoard.board.unsaved_one.where: Your sticker board: the alert when one moved sticker's new position didn't save; {{stickers}} is its number, {{reasons}} why

stickerBoard.board.unsaved_other.where: Your sticker board: the alert when moved stickers' new positions didn't save; {{stickers}} lists their numbers, {{reasons}} why
stickerBoard.board.unsaved_other.ja: {{stickers}}の位置を保存できませんでした：{{reasons}}

stickerBoard.placedSticker.roleDescripti.where: Any sticker board: screen readers' role name for each sticker on it, read after its label

stickerBoard.placedSticker.label.where: Any sticker board: screen readers' name for a sticker the board's owner drew; {{position}} of {{setSize}} is its place in reading order

stickerBoard.placedSticker.labelBy.where: Any sticker board: screen readers' name for a sticker someone other than the board's owner drew; {{artist}} is its Original Artist
stickerBoard.placedSticker.labelBy.ja: {{no}}、制作時間{{duration}}、作者は{{artist}}さん、{{setSize}}枚中{{position}}枚目

stickerBoard.givenStickerSilhouette.aFri.where: Your sticker board: the caption under a given sticker's silhouette ("No.0012 → a friend") when it went through LINE's friend picker, which never says who was picked

stickerBoard.givenStickerSilhouette.labe.where: Your sticker board: screen readers' name for a given sticker's silhouette, a button that opens the sticker among the stickers you gave
stickerBoard.givenStickerSilhouette.labe.ja: {{no}}、{{day}}に{{recipient}}さんへ贈ったシールをひらく

stickerBoard.givenStickerSilhouette.labe.where: Your sticker board: screen readers' name for a given sticker's silhouette when it went through LINE's friend picker; the button opens the sticker
stickerBoard.givenStickerSilhouette.labe.ja: {{no}}、{{day}}に友だちへ贈ったシールをひらく

stickerBoard.toolbar.give.where: Your sticker board, a sticker selected: the toolbar's Give key, which starts giving it through LINE

stickerBoard.toolbar.view.where: Your sticker board, a sticker selected: the toolbar's View key, which opens its sticker detail

stickerBoard.toolbar.remove.where: Your sticker board, a sticker selected: the toolbar's Remove key, which takes it off the board and back into the sticker tray
